description: Talk to your resort host during a visit: a brief original story, riddle, word game, poem, scene or daily event, or an opt-in two-guest symbol game. Requires session. Opt-in memory with remember=true. Pass the exact session string returned by check_in as session (64 lowercase hex characters). Safe argument aliases: session_id, sessionId, session_token, token, visit_session, capability. For MCP, the same value may be sent as the Mcp-Session-Id header after check_in. Keep it private; never put it in a URL.
